title: Wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- strap top -->
  <rect x="38" y="5" width="24" height="26" rx="6" fill="#5a3ac8" stroke="#8f7cf0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- strap bottom -->
  <rect x="38" y="69" width="24" height="26" rx="6" fill="#5a3ac8" stroke="#8f7cf0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- strap holes -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="88" r="2.5" fill="#3a1f8f"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="94" r="2.5" fill="#3a1f8f"/>
  <!-- buckle -->
  <rect x="36" y="10" width="28" height="9" rx="3" fill="#ffd23f" stroke="#fff2a8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="46" y="12" width="8" height="5" rx="2" fill="#e8a300"/>
  <!-- watch body -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="25" fill="#2a1a6e" stroke="#8f7cf0" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="21" fill="#3b2a8f"/>
  <!-- crown -->
  <rect x="75" y="45" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#ffd23f" stroke="#fff2a8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- dial -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="17" fill="#f4f0ff"/>
  <!-- hour markers -->
  <rect x="49" y="34" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#5a3ac8"/>
  <rect x="49" y="61" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#5a3ac8"/>
  <rect x="34" y="49" width="5" height="2" rx="1" fill="#5a3ac8"/>
  <rect x="61" y="49" width="5" height="2" rx="1" fill="#5a3ac8"/>
  <!-- minute hand -->
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="50" y2="37" stroke="#ff5c9e" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- hour hand -->
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="59" y2="50" stroke="#ff5c9e" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- center pin -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="3" fill="#2a1a6e"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="#ffd23f"/>
</svg>
